description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained BERT4Rec model through the host ModelView interface. It returns measured metrics with explicit definitions and builds an interpretation prompt grounded in those results.
motivation: Provide reliable feedback for model improvement while preserving benchmark comparability, preventing target leakage, and avoiding conclusions based on unavailable metadata or unobserved simulator traits.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Preserve log2feats(sequence), item_emb, and predict_score(features, items) compatibility with the actual trained module. Handle left padding using the final nonpadding position; use BERT4Rec's reserved mask token and appended-mask inference without exposing prediction targets. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Maintain one trained checkpoint per category and consistent predictor serialization. Route all four categories and select improvements by macro validation HR@10 under the fixed host evaluator. Native simulator recommendations cover twenty training users, five per category, over unseen catalog items.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    initialize(view, device)
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        evaluate actual view.model without gradients
        for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
            apply family-correct padding, masking, and target alignment
            obtain representations and scores through ModelView
            accumulate supported diagnostic measurements
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_values, metric_definitions: definitions}

function diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    state data availability and measurement limitations
    request evidence-grounded interpretations and single-model BERT4Rec improvements

originality.positive: Combines family-specific diagnostics, explicit metric definitions, and benchmark constraints in one adapter contract.
originality.negative: Primarily evaluation infrastructure; it introduces no new recommendation architecture or learning objective.

future_potential.positive: Could support repeatable diagnosis-driven improvements while preserving valid comparisons.
future_potential.negative: Utility depends on choosing informative probes and confirming hypotheses through validation; no gains are demonstrated in the supplied description.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch format provide clear integration points.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, left-padding alignment, metric aggregation, and checkpoint–predictor consistency require careful implementation.
